Definition: Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first
BiblicalUsage: Asaph = "gatherer"; 1) the father of Hezekiah's secretary; 2) a son of Berechiah, chief Levite musician under David; 3) a Persian officer over the royal forest
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
